title: lens lenticula
intro: Lens lenticula, commonly known as the Bearberry plant, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Europe and North America. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include being a natural remedy for urinary tract infections and helping to reduce the risk of kidney stones due to its diuretic and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include being used to treat conditions such as cystitis, urethritis, and prostatitis, as well as being used as a natural remedy for fever and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include arbutin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
